description: Official iKOOLCORE wiki references restyled with the built-in image editing tool (gpt-image-2). Explicit picker variants; never inferred from an Intel NIC OUI. Masters are not committed.

edits.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: OLR device picker thumbnail. Restyle the actual device in this official manufacturer reference; preserve its real silhouette, proportions, colors and port placement, but simplify rendering to match our device icon set. Clean device thumbnail illustration, like the device pictures in a phone's settings app. Shown straight-on from the front, perfectly symmetrical, upright, camera very slightly above. Clean simplified semi-realistic rendering, soft even lighting, crisp edges, designed to stay legible at 32 pixels. Single object centred, filling about 80% of the frame, plain pure white background, no shadow, no ground plane. No logos, no text, no UI, no brand marks. Reference is a collage: extract ONLY the upper central dark graphite-gray R1 enclosure, the face with one USB-C port and one thin TF card slot above two low copper-tinted cooling openings. Discard the lower second device view and ALL infographic panels. Render ONE complete compact cuboid, not a collage. Preserve dark gray metal, small rounded corners, thin top lid seam, tiny dark feet, width to body-height about 1.6:1, and show a small plain top surface. Simplify each cooling opening to one dark rounded rectangle with a subtle copper edge, no individual fins. Very minimal: a few large simple forms, no fine textures, no screws, no perforations, no cables, no small labels. This device has no screen.
